content: Hermes (RN's default JS engine) does not implement the Web Crypto API, so bare crypto.randomUUID()/crypto.getRandomValues() throws at runtime even under the New Architecture. Expo's own expo-crypto package (SDK-versioned, ~56.0.4 on the SDK 56 line) provides a native randomUUID() that works without polyfills and is already an Expo-ecosystem dependency, making it the lowest-friction choice for workout.id / strengthSet.id generation over a manual react-native-get-random-values polyfill + uuid package.
